instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium shot at eye-level. In a modern cafe with a large beige arched partition, the woman in the beige blazer and blue bandana (R1) sits on the left, gesturing with both hands as she speaks. Opposite her, the woman in the pink corduroy blazer and glasses (R2) sits in a wheelchair on the right, listening attentively with her hands resting in her lap. They are positioned around a small black table holding a single coffee cup. Warm, natural daylight illuminates the scene, casting soft shadows and highlighting the neutral beige and soft pink color palette.
